title: Type the bare catch clauses in the merge layer so they stop swallowing Error subtypes
rule: EH-4 (typed `on X catch`; never catch Error subtypes)
why: Neither catch has an `on <Type>` clause, so both trap Error subtypes (TypeError, RangeError, AssertionError) alongside genuine Exceptions. Per EH-4's stated rationale, that masks real programming bugs introduced by a future edit to these exact files: instead of crashing loudly with a stack trace in dev/QA, a regression degrades silently to a 'sync_learner_profile_merge_row_failed' warning log (site 1) or a silently-emptied schedule days-of-week list inside _encodeSchedule (site 2).
recommendation: Narrow both to `on Exception catch` (or the specific expected types, e.g. FormatException/SqliteException) and let genuine Error subtypes propagate and crash loudly.
acceptance_criteria: avoid_catches_without_on_clauses + avoid_catching_errors lints (EH-4's stated Pending checkers in coding-standards.md) pass for these two files.
Existing mergers_test.dart / learning_ledger_merger_test.dart suites still pass after narrowing.
